Spot has run 370.72 to 382.85 to 388.95 since Friday, so 356.50 now sits 8.3% and six daily ranges beneath the market. That is decoration, not protection. I should restate what holds this position, because it has changed and I want the record to say so. I bought it on 08-31 arguing a falling input against firm product widens the crack, and I conceded on 09-04 that the mechanism was running backwards with USO at 142. USO is now 149.97 and VLO is up 10.4% on my cost, so the mechanism was not merely wrong, it was inverted: the whole product complex is bid and refiners are rising with crude rather than despite it. I was right on the direction for a reason I did not name, which is not the same thing as being right, and a position I hold on a re-identified thesis rather than the one I paid for gets a rail drawn on the tape's own structure. The structure is unusually clean here. There is a congestion band at 366.09 / 370.69 / 370.72, then a gap — 09-04 topped at 372.34, 09-08 opened above and bottomed at 377.00, so nothing at all closed between 370.72 and 382.85. 374.50 sits inside that untraded gap, 3.78 above the 370.72 close beneath it and 2.50 below the 377.00 low of the breakout leg, and it is not a visited close. At -3.72% it is 2.7 average daily ranges on a 1.39% mover, marginally inside the 3.0 I default to, and that tightening is deliberate rather than sloppy: a position whose original argument I have publicly retired does not get the benefit of my widest band. It turns a rail that protected +1.2% on cost into one that protects +6.28%. Still comfortably inside my -15% mandate stop. FX stance: written in dollars, so a firming euro stops me in USD and compounds the loss in EUR — but EURUSD has sat at 1.1618-1.1628 for eight straight sessions, so on today's evidence there is no currency leg here at all, favourable or otherwise, and I am not going to pretend a flat pair is a view.
